profile.headline: Manager,  Software Development | MS Information Systems | 20 Years Development/Analyst Experience
profile.summary:
With over 10 years at Deluxe being both a Senior Software Developer and Software Development Manager, I focus on enhancing internal payment processing applications while ensuring PCI and SOX compliance. My contributions include safeguarding financial transactions, fraud detection, and managing merchant risk, supported by expertise in business analysis, research skills, and analytical reasoning.  

Dedicated to fostering collaboration, I mentor team members to achieve shared goals and embrace emerging technologies. Committed to continuous growth, I am pursuing a Master’s in Information Systems, earning recognition as the program's outstanding graduate, and have completed certifications to strengthen technical and managerial capabilities.

projects.title: An analysis on managing talent within organizational, management, and information technology
projects.description: The analysis is based off of a chapter from The Adventures of an IT Leader by Robert D. Austin, Richard L. Nolan, and Shannon O'Donnell. The paper goes into depth on chapter 15 and how the company is having issues with managing talent. My analysis is on how the fictional company IVK can improve issues at an organizational level, management level, and technology level. The paper offers viable solutions at each level and how they are rated against support recommendations. A recommendation is given for each sector on how the company can improve and retain and gain talent.

projects.title: Annotated Bibliography
projects.description: This paper uses academic research to explain why it is important in business to keep systems and software scalable and performing well when technology is constantly changing and companies continue to grow.
